pit_oakland_2026.source_name: Alameda County 2026 Point-in-Time Count, as reported by Local News Matters (Bay City News) and the City of Oakland
pit_oakland_2026.caveat: Preliminary. Single-night count. Local News Matters states the Oakland count fell from 5,485 in 2024 to 4,410 in 2026. The City release describes a 19.6 percent decline and does not print the integer 4,410 in the body text retrieved on 2026-10-03.

pit_oakland_share.unit: share of county total PIT count
pit_oakland_share.caveat: Preliminary. This is Oakland's share of the county's total count. A comparison to Oakland's share of county population was not in the retrieved release and is not shown.

pit_county_2026.source_name: Local News Matters report of Alameda County preliminary 2026 Point-in-Time results
pit_county_2026.caveat: Preliminary. Countywide total fell from 9,450 (2024) to 8,201 (2026). Unsheltered fell from 6,343 to 5,202.

pit_oakland_unsheltered.caveat: Preliminary. Single-night unsheltered count. The City release states the unsheltered count fell from 3,659 to 2,695.

ca_construction_employment.source_name: California Employment Development Department, July 2026 employment release
ca_construction_employment.caveat: Statewide, not Oakland-specific. July 2026 construction payroll jobs were 887,400, down 6,700 from July 2025. The same release shows a month-over construction gain of 2,900 from June 2026.

alameda_unemployment.source_name: California Employment Development Department, county table in the July 2026 release
alameda_unemployment.caveat: All industries. Preliminary. Not seasonally adjusted. Alameda County rate in the July 2026 county table is 4.6 percent.

us_construction_jobs_2025.source_name: Associated Builders and Contractors analysis, as cited by Underground Infrastructure
us_construction_jobs_2025.caveat: Industry-group analysis of federal data. National. Not re-verified against the article text in this build. Unverified.

sf_trades_survey_2023.source_name: San Francisco Standard report on a San Francisco Building Trades Council survey
sf_trades_survey_2023.caveat: Precedent only. Not Alameda County data. Not re-verified against the article text in this build. Unverified. BenchBridge does not have an Alameda County out-of-work count.

measure_u.source_name: SPUR voter guide, Oakland Measure U
measure_u.caveat: Authorization, not remaining balance. SPUR states an $850 million authorization, including $350 million for affordable housing preservation and anti-displacement. A 2024 proposal to tie Measure U to a project labor agreement was withdrawn; status after late 2024 is unverified — verify current status.

hcd_nc_nofa.unit: dollars reported by a secondary source
hcd_nc_nofa.source_name: Hoodline secondary report (not an Oakland HCD primary table in this cache)
hcd_nc_nofa.caveat: Secondary source. Not verified with Oakland HCD. Do not use in Judge Mode. Not shown on the map context strip.
